name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateAppProfile
description: Creates an app profile that tells Bigtable how to route a client application's requests across the clusters of an instance.
notes: App profiles must route to existing clusters and carry etags; a default single-cluster transactional profile is created with each instance.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateCluster
description: Adds a cluster to an existing instance in a chosen location, sized with a fixed node count or autoscaling limits.
notes: Cluster IDs are validated, serve_nodes/autoscaling/node_scaling_factor are stored, and DeleteCluster is blocked for the last cluster, for clusters holding backups and for clusters referenced by app-profile routing.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateInstance
description: Creates an instance together with its initial clusters, and returns a long-running operation that finishes when they are ready.
notes: Instances need a 6-33 character ID and at least one cluster; non-empty display names 4-30 characters (display_name is required and never defaulted); PartialUpdateInstance supports display_name/labels/type/edition and rejects PRODUCTION->DEVELOPMENT; deletion is blocked by protected resources or backups and cascades otherwise.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateLogicalView
description: Creates a logical view, a named SQL query over table data that applications can read like a table, within an instance.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.CreateMaterializedView
description: Creates a continuous materialized view, which keeps the results of an aggregation or reordering query up to date as the source table changes.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteAppProfile
description: Deletes an app profile from an instance, optionally skipping the safety checks about clients that still use it.
notes: App profiles must route to existing clusters and carry etags; a default single-cluster transactional profile is created with each instance.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteCluster
description: Permanently removes a cluster, and the replica of the instance's data that it holds, from an instance.
notes: DeleteCluster is blocked for the last cluster, for clusters holding unexpired backups for clusters referenced by single-cluster app-profile routing and, with automated backups enabled, for the cluster whose location a table's policy names unless another cluster remains there.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteInstance
description: Deletes an instance and everything it contains, including its clusters and tables.
notes: DeleteInstance is blocked by protected tables, views and backups, and otherwise cascades to every child resource.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteLogicalView
description: Deletes a logical view from an instance; the table data that the view's query reads is not affected.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.DeleteMaterializedView
description: Deletes a materialized view from an instance and stops maintaining its precomputed results.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.GetAppProfile
description: Returns the configuration of one app profile, including its routing policy and isolation settings.
notes: App profiles carry etags; UpdateAppProfile honors update_mask and etags and returns an UpdateAppProfile LRO.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.GetCluster
description: Returns the details of one cluster, such as its location, state, node count and storage type.
notes: Cluster IDs are validated, serve_nodes/autoscaling/node_scaling_factor are stored, and DeleteCluster is blocked for the last cluster, for clusters holding backups and for clusters referenced by app-profile routing.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.GetIamPolicy
description: Returns the IAM policy that controls who can access an instance and the resources inside it.
notes: Instance policies persist with etags and update_mask and require an existing instance; with --iam-enforce it reports the caller's real permissions and these methods require the matching permission.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.GetInstance
description: Returns the details of one instance, such as its display name, type, labels and state.
notes: Instances need a 6-33 character ID and at least one cluster; non-empty display names 4-30 characters (display_name is required and never defaulted); PartialUpdateInstance supports display_name/labels/type/edition and rejects PRODUCTION->DEVELOPMENT; deletion is blocked by protected resources or backups and cascades otherwise.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.GetLogicalView
description: Returns a logical view, including the SQL query that defines it.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.GetMaterializedView
description: Returns a materialized view, including the query that defines it and its settings.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.ListAppProfiles
description: Lists the app profiles defined in an instance, with their routing policies, one page at a time.
notes: ListInstances/ListClusters return one page (the proto has no page_size) and validate page tokens; ListAppProfiles paginates; '-' lists across instances.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.ListClusters
description: Lists the clusters of an instance, or of every instance in a project when the instance is given as a wildcard.
notes: ListInstances/ListClusters return one page (the proto has no page_size) and validate page tokens; ListAppProfiles paginates; '-' lists across instances.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.ListInstances
description: Lists the instances in a project, and reports any locations that could not be reached.
notes: ListInstances/ListClusters return one page (the proto has no page_size) and validate page tokens; ListAppProfiles paginates; '-' lists across instances.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.ListLogicalViews
description: Lists the logical views in an instance, one page at a time.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.ListMaterializedViews
description: Lists the materialized views in an instance, one page at a time.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.PartialUpdateCluster
description: Updates only the cluster fields named in an update mask, such as the node count or autoscaling configuration.
notes: UpdateCluster stores serve_nodes; PartialUpdateCluster supports serve_nodes, cluster_config.cluster_autoscaling_config and node_scaling_factor masks.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.PartialUpdateInstance
description: Updates only the instance fields named in an update mask, such as the display name, labels or type.
notes: PartialUpdateInstance supports display_name, labels, type and edition masks and returns a PartialUpdateInstance LRO.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.SetIamPolicy
description: Replaces the IAM policy of an instance, which changes who is allowed to access it.
notes: Instance policies persist with etags and update_mask and require an existing instance; with --iam-enforce it reports the caller's real permissions and these methods require the matching permission.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.TestIamPermissions
description: Returns the subset of the given permissions that the caller holds on an instance.
notes: Instance policies persist with etags and update_mask and require an existing instance; with --iam-enforce it reports the caller's real permissions and these methods require the matching permission.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.UpdateAppProfile
description: Changes the description, routing policy or isolation settings of an app profile, as selected by an update mask.
notes: App profiles carry etags; UpdateAppProfile honors update_mask and etags and returns an UpdateAppProfile LRO.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.UpdateCluster
description: Updates the serving configuration of a cluster, such as its node count, and returns a long-running operation.
notes: UpdateCluster stores serve_nodes; PartialUpdateCluster supports serve_nodes, cluster_config.cluster_autoscaling_config and node_scaling_factor masks.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.UpdateInstance
description: Updates the display name and type of an instance; other properties are changed with PartialUpdateInstance.
notes: UpdateInstance changes only display_name and type (PRODUCTION->DEVELOPMENT rejected); labels are left unchanged.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.UpdateLogicalView
description: Changes the SQL query or other settings of an existing logical view.

name: BigtableInstanceAdmin.UpdateMaterializedView
description: Updates the mutable settings of a materialized view, such as its deletion protection.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CheckConsistency
description: Checks whether replication has caught up on every cluster for writes made before a consistency token was generated.
notes: Tokens are validated per table and are always consistent because there is a single local replica.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CopyBackup
description: Copies a backup to a new backup in a destination cluster, which can be in another instance or project.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CreateAuthorizedView
description: Creates an authorized view of a table that exposes only chosen row prefixes, column families or column qualifiers.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CreateBackup
description: Starts creating a backup of a table in a cluster, with an expiration time, and returns a long-running operation.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CreateSchemaBundle
description: Creates a schema bundle in a table: a named collection of protocol buffer definitions for reading stored bytes as typed values.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.CreateTable
description: Creates a table in an instance with its initial column families, optional split points and timestamp granularity.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DeleteAuthorizedView
description: Deletes an authorized view of a table; the data in the table is not affected.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DeleteBackup
description: Deletes a backup of a table before it reaches its expiration time.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DeleteSchemaBundle
description: Deletes a schema bundle from a table; the stored data is not changed.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DeleteTable
description: Permanently deletes a table and all of its data, unless deletion protection is enabled on it.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.DropRowRange
description: Deletes all rows that share a key prefix, or every row in the table, without deleting the table itself.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GenerateConsistencyToken
description: Returns a token that CheckConsistency can later use to confirm that writes made up to now have replicated to every cluster.
notes: Tokens are validated per table and are always consistent because there is a single local replica.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetAuthorizedView
description: Returns an authorized view, including the subsets of the table that it exposes.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetBackup
description: Returns the metadata of one backup, such as its source table, size, state and expiration time.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetIamPolicy
description: Returns the IAM policy attached to a table, authorized view or backup.
notes: Policies persist with etags and update_mask, require existing resources and are removed with the table; with --iam-enforce it reports the caller's real permissions and these methods require the matching permission.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetSchemaBundle
description: Returns a schema bundle and the protocol buffer definitions that it holds.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.GetTable
description: Returns the details of one table, such as its column families and garbage collection rules.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ListAuthorizedViews
description: Lists the authorized views defined on a table, one page at a time.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ListBackups
description: Lists the backups in a cluster, or in every cluster of an instance, with optional filtering and ordering.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ListSchemaBundles
description: Lists the schema bundles in a table, one page at a time.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ListTables
description: Lists the tables in an instance, optionally with their full schema, one page at a time.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.ModifyColumnFamilies
description: Creates, updates or drops column families of a table in one request, including changes to their garbage collection rules.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.RestoreTable
description: Creates a new table by restoring a completed backup, and returns a long-running operation.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.SetIamPolicy
description: Replaces the IAM policy attached to a table, authorized view or backup, which changes who is allowed to access it.
notes: Policies persist with etags and update_mask, require existing resources and are removed with the table; with --iam-enforce it reports the caller's real permissions and these methods require the matching permission.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.TestIamPermissions
description: Returns the subset of the given permissions that the caller holds on a table, authorized view or backup.
notes: Policies persist with etags and update_mask, require existing resources and are removed with the table; with --iam-enforce it reports the caller's real permissions and these methods require the matching permission.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UndeleteTable
description: Restores a table that was accidentally deleted, as long as it is still within the deletion retention period.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UpdateAuthorizedView
description: Changes the subsets of a table that an authorized view exposes, or its deletion protection setting.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UpdateBackup
description: Updates a pending or completed backup's mutable settings, such as its expiration time.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UpdateSchemaBundle
description: Replaces the protocol buffer definitions held in a schema bundle.

name: BigtableTableAdmin.UpdateTable
description: Updates table settings such as deletion protection, change stream retention or automated backup policy, as selected by an update mask.

name: Bigtable.CheckAndMutateRow
description: Applies one of two sets of mutations to a row depending on whether a filter matches it, in one atomic step.

name: Bigtable.ExecuteQuery
description: Runs a SQL query that was prepared earlier and streams the result rows back to the client.

name: Bigtable.GenerateInitialChangeStreamPartitions
description: Returns the partitions that together cover a table's key space, from which a change stream reader starts reading.
notes: Returns the current local partition map: one full-keyspace partition until Server.SplitChangeStreamPartitions or MergeChangeStreamPartitions change it, always tiling the keyspace; tables without change_stream_config are FailedPrecondition.

name: Bigtable.MutateRow
description: Applies a list of changes to one row atomically: writing cells, deleting cells, or deleting whole column families or the row.

name: Bigtable.MutateRows
description: Applies changes to many rows in one request; each row's changes are atomic and the response reports a status for every row.

name: Bigtable.PingAndWarm
description: Warms up the connection and the instance metadata for a client before it starts sending real requests.
notes: Validates the instance name, the instance when strict admin mode is on, and the app profile; there is no distributed metadata cache to warm, so success is a no-op.

name: Bigtable.PrepareQuery
description: Parses and plans a SQL query, returning a prepared query and the shape of its result for later execution.

name: Bigtable.ReadChangeStream
description: Streams the changes made to one range of a table's key space, including user writes and garbage collection deletions.
notes: Records come from a transactional outbox written with each row commit: one DataChange per commit with grouped chunks, USER and GARBAGE_COLLECTION types, DeleteFromRow expanded to DeleteFromFamily per family, opaque continuation tokens, heartbeats whose low watermarks never pass an in-flight commit, a start_time bounded by the persisted enablement time, CloseStream OK at end_time and OUT_OF_RANGE with child tokens after a simulated split or merge.

name: Bigtable.ReadModifyWriteRow
description: Atomically appends bytes to, or adds a number to, the latest value of each named column, and returns the new values.

name: Bigtable.ReadRows
description: Streams rows from a table in key order, selected by key or key range and optionally filtered or limited.

name: Bigtable.SampleRowKeys
description: Returns row keys sampled across a table, with approximate data offsets, so clients can split work into similar-sized ranges.
notes: SampleRowKeys honors row_range and returns the table's initial split keys plus one sample every 512KiB of stored data, ending with the range end key or the empty end-of-table key carrying the total offset.

name: Operations.GetOperation
description: Returns the latest state of a long-running operation, such as whether it has finished and its result or error.
notes: Every LRO-returning admin RPC registers a durable operation (operations/<resource>/locations/local/operations/<n>) with its documented metadata type.

name: Operations.ListOperations
description: Lists the long-running operations that belong to a project, optionally filtered, one page at a time.
notes: ListOperations filters by name prefix and done=true| false, paginates, rejects other filters and answers return_partial_success with Unimplemented.

name: Operations.WaitOperation
description: Blocks until a long-running operation finishes or a timeout passes, then returns its latest state.
notes: Wait returns the completed operation immediately, Delete removes it, and Cancel is a no-op for done operations.

name: ReadRowsRequest.table_name
description: Names the table to read from, in the form projects/PROJECT/instances/INSTANCE/tables/TABLE.

name: ReadRowsRequest.rows
description: Selects which rows to read, as a set of individual row keys and key ranges; when unset, every row is read.

name: ReadRowsRequest.filter
description: Applies a row filter to each row read, so only matching cells are returned or their contents are transformed.

name: ReadRowsRequest.rows_limit
description: Caps how many rows are returned before the read stops; zero, the default, means no limit.

name: ReadRowsRequest.reversed
description: Reads rows in descending key order instead of the default ascending order, starting from the end of the key range.

name: ReadRowsRequest.request_stats_view
description: Chooses how much statistics information about the read the server sends back with the final response.

name: ReadRowsRequest.authorized_view_name
description: Names an authorized view to read through instead of the table, which limits the read to the data the view exposes.

name: ReadRowsRequest.app_profile_id
description: Names the app profile that decides how the read is routed; the default profile is used when it is empty.

name: ReadRowsRequest.materialized_view_name
description: Names a materialized view to read from instead of a table, returning the view's precomputed rows.

name: SampleRowKeysRequest.table_name
description: Names the table whose row keys are sampled, in the form projects/PROJECT/instances/INSTANCE/tables/TABLE.
notes: Table-targeted sampling restricted to row_range returns split keys and 512KiB samples inside the range.

name: SampleRowKeysRequest.row_range
description: Limits the sampled row keys to a single range of the key space instead of the whole table.
notes: Table-targeted sampling restricted to row_range returns split keys and 512KiB samples inside the range.

name: SampleRowKeysRequest.authorized_view_name
description: Names an authorized view to sample instead of a table, so only keys inside the view are returned.

name: SampleRowKeysRequest.app_profile_id
description: Names the app profile used to route the sampling request; the default profile is used when it is empty.

name: SampleRowKeysRequest.materialized_view_name
description: Names a materialized view whose row keys are sampled instead of a table's.

name: MutateRowRequest.table_name
description: Names the table that holds the row to change, in the form projects/PROJECT/instances/INSTANCE/tables/TABLE.

name: MutateRowRequest.row_key
description: Gives the key of the one row that receives the mutations.

name: MutateRowRequest.mutations
description: Lists the changes to apply to the row, in order, as one atomic update; at least one mutation is required.

name: MutateRowRequest.authorized_view_name
description: Names an authorized view to write through instead of the table, which restricts the write to data the view exposes.

name: MutateRowRequest.app_profile_id
description: Names the app profile used to route the write; the default profile is used when it is empty.

name: MutateRowsRequest.table_name
description: Names the table that all the entries are written to, in the form projects/PROJECT/instances/INSTANCE/tables/TABLE.

name: MutateRowsRequest.entries
description: Lists the rows to change, each with its own key and mutations; every entry is atomic but entries may apply in any order.

name: MutateRowsRequest.authorized_view_name
description: Names an authorized view to write through instead of the table, so every entry must fall inside the view.

name: MutateRowsRequest.app_profile_id
description: Names the app profile used to route the bulk write; the default profile is used when it is empty.

name: CheckAndMutateRowRequest.table_name
description: Names the table that holds the row to check and change, in the form projects/PROJECT/instances/INSTANCE/tables/TABLE.

name: CheckAndMutateRowRequest.row_key
description: Gives the key of the single row that is checked and then conditionally mutated.

name: CheckAndMutateRowRequest.predicate_filter
description: Gives the filter run against the row; if it yields at least one cell the true mutations apply, otherwise the false ones.

name: CheckAndMutateRowRequest.true_mutations
description: Lists the changes applied to the row when the predicate filter yields at least one cell.

name: CheckAndMutateRowRequest.false_mutations
description: Lists the changes applied to the row when the predicate filter yields no cells.

name: CheckAndMutateRowRequest.authorized_view_name
description: Names an authorized view to use instead of the table, so both the check and the changes see only the view's data.

name: CheckAndMutateRowRequest.app_profile_id
description: Names the app profile used to route the conditional write; the default profile is used when it is empty.

name: ReadModifyWriteRowRequest.table_name
description: Names the table that holds the row to modify, in the form projects/PROJECT/instances/INSTANCE/tables/TABLE.

name: ReadModifyWriteRowRequest.row_key
description: Gives the key of the row whose latest cell values are read and modified.

name: ReadModifyWriteRowRequest.rules
description: Lists the append or increment rules to apply to the row's cells, in order, as one atomic read-modify-write.

name: ReadModifyWriteRowRequest.authorized_view_name
description: Names an authorized view to modify through instead of the table, which limits the rules to cells the view exposes.

name: ReadModifyWriteRowRequest.app_profile_id
description: Names the app profile used to route the read-modify-write; the default profile is used when it is empty.

name: CreateTableRequest.parent
description: Names the instance in which the new table is created, in the form projects/PROJECT/instances/INSTANCE.

name: CreateTableRequest.table_id
description: Gives the ID of the new table, which becomes the last part of its full name and must be unique within the instance.

name: CreateTableRequest.table
description: Describes the table to create, including its column families, garbage collection rules, timestamp granularity and settings.

name: CreateTableRequest.initial_splits
description: Lists row keys at which to pre-split the table into tablets when it is created, which can spread early load.

name: ColumnFamily.gc_rule
description: Sets the garbage collection rule that decides which old cell versions in the family Bigtable deletes automatically.
notes: Nested union/intersection rules use production semantics; max_age below 1ms and rules over 500 bytes are rejected.

name: ColumnFamily.value_type
description: Declares the data type of cell values in the family, including aggregate types whose cells combine values on write.

name: chain
description: Passes the row through a list of filters in order, so each filter sees only the cells the previous filter kept.

name: interleave
description: Runs several filters on the same row in parallel and merges all their results, keeping duplicates when filters overlap.

name: condition
description: Picks which filter to apply to a row by first running a predicate filter and checking whether it returns any cell.

name: sink
description: Sends the cells that reach it straight to the final output of the read, bypassing the rest of the enclosing filters.

name: pass_all_filter
description: Keeps every cell of the row regardless of input, which is equivalent to applying no filter at all.

name: block_all_filter
description: Drops every cell regardless of input, which is useful for temporarily disabling one part of a larger filter.

name: row_key_regex_filter
description: Keeps only the rows whose key fully matches a regular expression written in RE2 syntax.

name: row_sample_filter
description: Keeps each row with a given probability between 0 and 1, which returns a random sample of the table.

name: family_name_regex_filter
description: Keeps only the cells whose column family name fully matches a regular expression.

name: column_qualifier_regex_filter
description: Keeps only the cells whose column qualifier fully matches a regular expression.

name: column_range_filter
description: Keeps cells in one column family whose qualifiers fall between a start and an end qualifier, each inclusive or exclusive.

name: timestamp_range_filter
description: Keeps cells whose timestamps fall in a half-open range, with the start included and the end excluded.

name: value_regex_filter
description: Keeps only the cells whose stored value fully matches a regular expression written in RE2 syntax.

name: value_range_filter
description: Keeps cells whose value falls between a start and an end value, each bound inclusive or exclusive.

name: cells_per_row_offset_filter
description: Skips the first N cells of each row and returns the remaining cells, counting in the order they are stored.

name: cells_per_row_limit_filter
description: Keeps only the first N cells of each row, counting in the order they are stored, and drops the rest.

name: cells_per_column_limit_filter
description: Keeps only the N most recent versions of each column, which is useful for reading just the latest value.

name: strip_value_transformer
description: Replaces every cell value with an empty value while keeping keys, columns and timestamps, which saves bandwidth when only the cell existence matters.

name: apply_label_transformer
description: Adds a text label to every cell it passes, so results from different interleaved filters can be told apart.

name: value_bitmask_filter
description: Keeps cells whose value has all the bits of a mask set; the mask must be exactly as long as the value.

name: max_num_versions
description: Keeps at most N newest versions of each cell in a column and lets the older versions be deleted.

name: max_age
description: Lets cells older than a given duration be deleted, measured from each cell's timestamp.

name: intersection
description: Combines rules so that a cell is deleted only when every one of the rules says it can be deleted.

name: union
description: Combines rules so that a cell is deleted as soon as any one of the rules says it can be deleted.

name: set_cell
description: Writes a value into one cell, identified by column family, column qualifier and timestamp.

name: add_to_cell
description: Adds an input value to the aggregate stored in a cell of an aggregate column family, without reading the cell first.

name: merge_to_cell
description: Merges an already aggregated intermediate value, such as a HyperLogLog++ sketch, into the aggregate stored in a cell.

name: delete_from_column
description: Deletes the versions of a single column, optionally only those inside a timestamp range.

name: delete_from_family
description: Deletes every cell of one column family from the row.

name: delete_from_row
description: Deletes all of the row's cells in every column family, which removes the row.

name: append_value
description: Appends bytes to the end of the latest value of a cell, creating the cell if it does not exist, and returns the result.

name: increment_amount
description: Adds a signed 64-bit amount to the latest value of a cell, read as a big-endian integer, and returns the new value.

name: Sum<Int64>
description: A column family type whose cells hold a running sum of the 64-bit integers added to them.

name: Min<Int64>
description: A column family type whose cells hold the smallest 64-bit integer written to them so far.

name: Max<Int64>
description: A column family type whose cells hold the largest 64-bit integer written to them so far.

name: HLL++
description: A column family type whose cells hold a HyperLogLog++ sketch that estimates how many distinct values were added.
notes: Local sketch bytes are not production-compatible.

name: Strict instance existence checks
description: Requests that name an instance, cluster or table that does not exist fail with a not-found error instead of being accepted.

name: Table deletion protection
description: A table can be flagged so that delete requests for it fail until the flag is removed.

name: Deletion protection across restart
description: A table's deletion protection setting is stored durably and stays in force through restarts and maintenance.

name: Soft-deleted table recovery
description: A deleted table is kept for a retention period during which it can be restored together with its data.

name: Backup row snapshots
description: A backup captures a consistent copy of a table's data that does not change when the source table is modified later.

name: Backup schema snapshots
description: A backup records the table's column families and garbage collection rules so that a restore can recreate them.

name: Backup expiry validation
description: Every backup needs an expiration time that must fall inside an allowed window, after which the backup is deleted automatically.

name: Backup type validation
description: Backups can be standard or hot, and a hot backup can be set to convert to a standard backup at a chosen time.

name: Backup copy restrictions
description: A backup can be copied to another cluster, subject to rules such as the source being ready and limits on the copy's expiration.

name: Automated backup scheduling
description: A table can have an automated backup policy that creates backups on a schedule and keeps them for a set retention period.
notes: A scheduler creates one auto backup per cluster every 24 h while the server runs (CLI default on, -automated-backup-interval); no backfill, no time-of-day alignment; an undeleted table loses its policy; no CreateAutomatedBackup log events.

name: Change-stream enable/disable
description: Change streams are switched on or off for a table by setting or clearing its change stream retention period.

name: Change-stream retention purge
description: Change records are kept for the table's configured retention period and are removed once they are older than it.

name: Grouped change records per row commit
description: Mutations written to a row together are reported together as one data change record in the stream.

name: Change-stream continuation tokens
description: A reader receives opaque tokens that let it resume the stream from where it stopped without missing or repeating changes.

name: Change-stream heartbeats
description: The stream periodically sends heartbeat messages with a continuation token and low watermark, even when no data changes.

name: GC change records
description: Cells removed by garbage collection appear in the change stream as records marked as coming from garbage collection.

name: Range-deletion change records
description: Rows removed with the DropRowRange admin call are captured in the change stream as data change records.

name: Change-stream partition splits
description: When a tablet splits, the stream of its partition ends and tells readers which new partitions to read instead.
notes: Local simulation: Server.SplitChangeStreamPartitions or the opt-in -change-stream-split-after flag persists ranges and closes the parent with child tokens; not tablet balancing and not an RPC.

name: Change-stream partition merges
description: When tablets merge, the streams of the merged partitions end and readers continue on the new, larger partition.
notes: Local simulation: Server.MergeChangeStreamPartitions or the opt-in -change-stream-split-after flag; a merge needs a token from every parent; parents may finish in any order.

name: Authorized-view row-prefix restrictions
description: An authorized view can limit readers and writers to rows whose keys start with chosen prefixes.

name: Authorized-view family restrictions
description: An authorized view can expose only chosen column families of a table.

name: Authorized-view qualifier restrictions
description: An authorized view can expose only chosen column qualifiers or qualifier prefixes within a column family.

name: Authorized-view write restrictions
description: Writes made through an authorized view are rejected when they touch rows, families or columns that the view does not expose.

name: Protobuf schema validation
description: The protocol buffer descriptors in a schema bundle are validated when the bundle is created or updated.

name: Prepared-query parameters
description: A prepared SQL query declares named parameters whose values are supplied each time the query is executed.

name: Prepared-query refresh after schema changes
description: A prepared query expires after schema changes or over time, and the client prepares it again to keep executing it.

name: Logical-view query execution
description: Reading a logical view runs its stored SQL query against the underlying table data at read time.

name: Parameterized logical-view definitions
description: A parameterized logical view reads caller-supplied string parameters with VIEW_PARAMETERS to scope its results to a user or tenant.

name: CMV GROUP BY definitions
description: A continuous materialized view can group rows by chosen columns and keep aggregates such as counts and sums up to date.
notes: See function table.

name: CMV ORDER BY secondary indexes
description: A continuous materialized view can use ORDER BY to store rows under a different key, acting as an asynchronous secondary index.
notes: See function table.

name: CMV read refresh
description: A continuous materialized view is maintained in the background, so reads see source changes after a short delay.
notes: Default recomputes before each read; opt-in -cmv-refresh-interval refreshes in the background so reads lag until the next refresh; opt-in -cmv-incremental applies only changed rows for the 12 aggregate forms; SQL over a view is always current.

name: CMV definitions across restart
description: A continuous materialized view definition is stored durably and keeps being maintained through service restarts.

name: Production-compatible HLL++ sketch bytes
description: HyperLogLog++ sketches in aggregate cells are stored as bytes in a standard encoding that the HLL_COUNT functions can read and merge.
notes: HLL_COUNT.* read and write ZetaSketch v2 bytes verified against independent vectors; aggregate-family cells assume the same bytes at precision 15; v1 sketches are rejected.

name: Asynchronous GC timing
description: Garbage collection runs in the background on its own schedule, so cells past their rules can stay readable for a while.
notes: Default collects eagerly; opt-in -gc-interval leaves eligible cells readable until a background collector deletes them; No reproduction of Google's compaction schedule.

name: IAM identity enforcement
description: Each request is checked against IAM policies, and callers without the needed permission are denied.
notes: Opt-in --iam-mode off/audit/enforce: five local predefined roles, or project bindings and role definitions from configured Resource Manager and IAM endpoints; conditions are decided by the IAM service with the caller's token; no groups, deny policies or organization policy.

name: Authenticated service connections
description: Clients authenticate with Google credentials, so every request carries the identity of a user or service account.
notes: Opt-in local Ed25519 bearer tokens, or OAuth access tokens validated through a configured tokeninfo endpoint; no ID tokens, ADC or credential issuance.

name: Cloud Monitoring integration
description: Bigtable publishes usage and performance metrics, such as CPU load and request latency, to Cloud Monitoring.
notes: Writes 8 measured server metrics to a configured Monitoring endpoint (-monitoring-endpoint); CPU load, capacity and replication metrics are not synthesized.

name: Cloud Audit Logs
description: Bigtable records administrative actions as Admin Activity entries, and data reads and writes as Data Access entries when enabled, in Cloud Logging.
notes: Admin Activity and optional Data Access entries for the documented methods go to a configured Logging endpoint (-logging-endpoint); no request payloads or row data.

name: ListLocations
description: Lists the Google Cloud locations where Bigtable is available to a project.
notes: Registers google.cloud.location.Locations with Bigtable's 130 published zones (page of 2026-10-23), a local entry and the project's cluster locations, an AIP-160 filter subset and pagination; entries provision nothing.

name: RouteLookup
description: Returns the target that a client should send requests for a given key to, using the gRPC route lookup protocol.
notes: Answers target_type grpc with the emulator's own address and the routed cluster ids, validating instance, app_profile_id and table; message shapes match the documented proto, keys and error codes are local conventions.

name: TLS encryption in transit
description: Traffic between clients and Bigtable is encrypted in transit with TLS.

name: CMV CLUSTER_ATTRIBUTE routing
description: CLUSTER_ATTRIBUTE returns an attribute of the cluster processing a continuous materialized view query, so a view can be limited to one cluster.
notes: Single-cluster app-profile routing returns cluster_id and keeps one view copy per cluster; multi-cluster routing is rejected; ignore_warnings is a local gRPC header.

name: Temporal table filters
description: Options on a table in a SQL query, such as with_history, after, before and latest_n, return timestamped cell versions within a time window.

name: ABS
description: Returns the absolute value of a number, and raises an error when negating the most negative integer would overflow.

name: ACOS
description: Returns the inverse cosine of a number between -1 and 1, as an angle in radians from 0 to pi.

name: ACOSH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a number that is at least 1.

name: ANY_VALUE
description: Returns the expression's value from one arbitrarily chosen row of a group, when it does not matter which row supplies it.

name: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT
description: Estimates how many distinct values a column holds, faster and with less memory than an exact count of distinct values.

name: APPROX_QUANTILES
description: Returns approximate quantile boundaries of a column's values, from the approximate minimum through to the maximum.

name: APPROX_TOP_COUNT
description: Returns the most frequent values of a column together with their approximate occurrence counts.

name: APPROX_TOP_SUM
description: Returns the values with the largest approximate total of an associated weight column, along with those totals.

name: ARRAY_AGG
description: Collects the values of a group of rows into a single array in no guaranteed order, optionally de-duplicated and with NULLs ignored or kept.

name: ARRAY_CONCAT
description: Joins one or more arrays of the same type into a single array, in the order given.

name: ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG
description: Concatenates the arrays from all the rows of a group into one single array, optionally ignoring duplicate arrays.

name: ARRAY_FILTER
description: Returns a new array holding only the elements for which a lambda condition is true, in their original order.

name: ARRAY_FIRST
description: Returns the first element of an array, and raises an error if the array is empty.

name: ARRAY_INCLUDES
description: Returns TRUE when an array contains a given search value, and NULL when either argument is NULL.

name: ARRAY_INCLUDES_ALL
description: Returns TRUE only when every value in a list of search values is present in an array.

name: ARRAY_INCLUDES_ANY
description: Returns TRUE when at least one value from a list of search values is present in an array.

name: ARRAY_IS_DISTINCT
description: Returns TRUE when an array has no repeated elements, using the same equality rules as SELECT DISTINCT.

name: ARRAY_LAST
description: Returns the last element of an array, and raises an error if the array is empty.

name: ARRAY_LAST_N
description: Returns an array holding the last N elements of an input array, and raises an error if N is negative.

name: ARRAY_LENGTH
description: Returns the number of elements in an array: zero for an empty array and NULL when the array is NULL.

name: ARRAY_OFFSET
description: Returns the zero-based position of the first, or optionally the last, element equal to a search value, or NULL if none matches.

name: ARRAY_OFFSETS
description: Returns an array of the zero-based positions of every element equal to a search value, which is empty when none matches.

name: ARRAY_REVERSE
description: Returns a copy of an array with the order of its elements reversed, so the last element comes first.

name: ARRAY_SLICE
description: Returns the run of consecutive elements between a start and an end offset, both inclusive, as a new array.

name: ARRAY_TO_STRING
description: Joins the elements of an array into one string with a delimiter, replacing NULL elements with optional text or skipping them.

name: ARRAY_TRANSFORM
description: Returns a new array of the same length in which a lambda expression has been applied to every element.

name: ASCII
description: Returns the ASCII code of the first character or byte of a value, or 0 when the value is empty.

name: ASIN
description: Returns the inverse sine of a number between -1 and 1, as an angle in radians between minus and plus pi over two.

name: ASINH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number; it is defined for every input.

name: ATAN
description: Returns the inverse tangent of a number, as an angle in radians between minus and plus pi over two.

name: ATAN2
description: Returns the inverse tangent of the ratio of its two arguments, using their signs to pick the correct quadrant.

name: ATANH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number strictly between -1 and 1.

name: AVG
description: Returns the arithmetic mean of the non-NULL numeric values in a group of rows.

name: BIT_AND
description: Returns the bitwise AND of all non-NULL integer or bytes values in a group of rows.

name: BIT_OR
description: Returns the bitwise OR of all non-NULL integer or bytes values in a group of rows.

name: BIT_XOR
description: Returns the bitwise XOR of all non-NULL integer or bytes values in a group of rows.

name: BYTE_LENGTH
description: Returns the number of bytes in a string or bytes value, which differs from its character count for non-ASCII text.

name: CASE
description: Evaluates conditions in order and returns the result paired with the first one that is true, or an optional default.

name: CAST
description: Converts a value to a specified type, and raises an error at run time if the conversion is not possible.

name: CEIL
description: Returns the smallest whole number that is greater than or equal to the input.

name: CEILING
description: A synonym of CEIL: rounds a number up to the nearest whole number that is not smaller than it.

name: CHAR_LENGTH
description: Returns the number of characters in a string, counting each Unicode character once.

name: CHR
description: Returns the one-character string for a Unicode code point, an empty string for 0, and an error for invalid code points.

name: CLUSTER_ATTRIBUTE
description: Returns an attribute of the cluster that is processing a continuous materialized view query, such as its cluster ID.

name: CODE_POINTS_TO_BYTES
description: Builds a bytes value from an array of integers between 0 and 255, one byte per integer.

name: CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING
description: Builds a string from an array of Unicode code points, one character per integer.

name: CONCAT
description: Joins one or more strings, or one or more bytes values, into one value, and returns NULL if any input is NULL.

name: CORR
description: Returns the Pearson correlation coefficient of two numeric columns over a group of rows.

name: COS
description: Returns the cosine of an angle given in radians, as a value between -1 and 1.

name: COSH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a number, and raises an error if the result overflows.

name: COSINE_DISTANCE
description: Returns the cosine distance between two vectors of equal length, which measures how far apart their directions are.

name: COT
description: Returns the cotangent of an angle given in radians, and raises an error when the angle is zero.

name: COTH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cotangent of a number, and raises an error when the number is zero.

name: COUNT
description: Returns the number of rows in a group, or the number of rows where an expression is not NULL.

name: COUNTIF
description: Returns the number of rows in a group for which a Boolean condition is true.

name: COVAR_POP
description: Returns the population covariance of two numeric columns over a group of rows.

name: COVAR_SAMP
description: Returns the sample covariance of two numeric columns over a group of rows.

name: CSC
description: Returns the cosecant of an angle given in radians, and raises an error when the angle is zero.

name: CSCH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cosecant of a number, and raises an error when the number is zero.

name: CUME_DIST
description: Returns the fraction of rows in a window partition that come at or before the current row in the ordering.

name: CURRENT_DATE
description: Returns the current date, using UTC unless a time zone is specified.

name: CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
description: Returns the current date and time as a timestamp value in UTC.

name: DATE
description: Builds a date from a year, month and day, or extracts the date part of a timestamp or datetime.

name: DATE_ADD
description: Adds a number of days, weeks, months, quarters or years to a date and returns the resulting date.

name: DATE_DIFF
description: Returns the number of date-part boundaries, such as days or months, between two dates, truncating any fraction.

name: DATE_FROM_UNIX_DATE
description: Converts an integer count of days since 1970-01-01 into the corresponding calendar date.

name: DATE_SUB
description: Subtracts a number of days, weeks, months, quarters or years from a date and returns the resulting date.

name: DATE_TRUNC
description: Rounds a date down to the start of a chosen part, such as its week, month, quarter or year.

name: DENSE_RANK
description: Returns the rank of the current row within its window partition, giving tied rows the same rank and leaving no gaps.

name: DIV
description: Returns the integer part of dividing one integer by another, and raises an error on division by zero.

name: ENDS_WITH
description: Returns TRUE when a value ends with the given suffix, for both strings and bytes.

name: EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE
description: Returns the straight-line distance between two vectors of equal length.

name: EXP
description: Returns e raised to the power of a number, giving zero on underflow and an error on overflow.

name: EXTRACT
description: Pulls one part, such as the year, month, day or hour, out of a date or timestamp value.

name: FIRST_VALUE
description: Returns the value of an expression from the first row of the current window frame.

name: FLOOR
description: Returns the largest whole number that is less than or equal to the input.

name: FORMAT
description: Builds a string from a format pattern with printf-style specifiers and the values that fill them.

name: FORMAT_DATE
description: Converts a date to a string using a format pattern made of year, month and day elements.

name: FORMAT_TIMESTAMP
description: Converts a timestamp to a string using a format pattern, optionally in a given time zone.

name: FROM_BASE32
description: Decodes a base32-encoded string into a bytes value.

name: FROM_BASE64
description: Decodes a base64-encoded string into a bytes value.

name: FROM_HEX
description: Decodes a hexadecimal string into a bytes value, and raises an error for characters outside the hexadecimal range.

name: GENERATE_ARRAY
description: Returns an array of integers or floating-point numbers from a start to an end value, stepping by a given increment.

name: GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY
description: Returns an array of dates from a start date to an end date, stepping by a given interval, one day by default.

name: GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY
description: Returns an array of timestamps from a start to an end timestamp, spaced by a given interval.

name: GREATEST
description: Returns the largest of its arguments, or NULL when any argument is NULL.

name: HLL_COUNT.EXTRACT
description: Returns the estimated number of distinct values recorded in one HyperLogLog++ sketch.

name: HLL_COUNT.INIT
description: Aggregates input values into a new HyperLogLog++ sketch, returned as bytes, that can later be merged or counted.

name: HLL_COUNT.MERGE
description: Merges several HyperLogLog++ sketches and returns the estimated distinct count across all of them.

name: HLL_COUNT.MERGE_PARTIAL
description: Merges several HyperLogLog++ sketches into one new sketch, returned as bytes, without computing a count.

name: IEEE_DIVIDE
description: Divides two numbers and returns infinity or NaN instead of raising an error when the divisor is zero.

name: IF
description: Evaluates a condition and returns the first value when it is true, otherwise the second value.

name: IFERROR
description: Evaluates an expression and returns its result, or returns a replacement value if evaluating it raises an error.

name: IFNULL
description: Returns a replacement value when an expression is NULL, and otherwise returns the expression itself.

name: INITCAP
description: Capitalizes the first letter of each word in a string and lowercases the rest, using default or custom word delimiters.

name: INSTR
description: Returns the 1-based position of a substring within a value, with optional start and occurrence, or 0 if it is not found.

name: ISERROR
description: Returns TRUE if evaluating an expression raises an error, and FALSE otherwise.

name: IS_INF
description: Returns TRUE if a floating-point value is positive or negative infinity.

name: IS_NAN
description: Returns TRUE if a floating-point value is NaN, meaning not a number.

name: JSON_EXTRACT
description: Returns the JSON value at a path as a JSON-formatted string; an older function superseded by JSON_QUERY.

name: JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR
description: Returns the scalar JSON value at a path as an unquoted string; an older function superseded by JSON_VALUE.

name: JSON_QUERY
description: Returns the JSON value found at a path inside a JSON string, as a JSON-formatted string.

name: JSON_QUERY_ARRAY
description: Returns the JSON array found at a path as an array of JSON-formatted strings, one per element.

name: JSON_VALUE
description: Returns the scalar JSON value found at a path as an unquoted string, or NULL if the value is not a scalar.

name: LAG
description: Returns the value of an expression from a row that comes a given number of rows before the current row in its window.

name: LAST_DAY
description: Returns the last day of the month, or of another chosen period such as the year or week, that contains a date.

name: LAST_VALUE
description: Returns the value of an expression from the last row of the current window frame.

name: LEAD
description: Returns the value of an expression from a row that comes a given number of rows after the current row in its window.

name: LEAST
description: Returns the smallest of its arguments, or NULL when any argument is NULL.

name: LEFT
description: Returns the leftmost characters of a string, or the leftmost bytes of a bytes value, up to the requested length.

name: LENGTH
description: Returns the length of a value, counted in characters for strings and in bytes for bytes values.

name: LN
description: Returns the natural logarithm of a number, and raises an error if the number is zero or negative.

name: LOG
description: Returns the natural logarithm of a number, or its logarithm to a given base when a base is supplied.

name: LOG10
description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number, and raises an error if the number is zero or negative.

name: LOGICAL_AND
description: Returns TRUE only if a Boolean expression is true for every non-NULL row in a group.

name: LOGICAL_OR
description: Returns TRUE if a Boolean expression is true for at least one non-NULL row in a group.

name: LOWER
description: Converts the letters in a string to lowercase, or the ASCII letters in a bytes value.

name: LPAD
description: Pads the start of a value with a repeating pattern until it reaches a target length, or truncates it if it is longer.

name: LTRIM
description: Removes the given characters, or spaces by default, from the start of a string or bytes value.

name: MAP_CONTAINS_KEY
description: Returns whether a map holds an entry for a given key.

name: MAP_EMPTY
description: Returns TRUE when a map has no entries and FALSE otherwise.

name: MAP_ENTRIES
description: Returns the entries of a map as an array of key and value structs ordered by ascending key.

name: MAP_KEYS
description: Returns the keys of a map as an array, sorted in ascending order.

name: MAP_VALUES
description: Returns the values of a map as an array, ordered by their keys in ascending order.

name: MAX
description: Returns the largest non-NULL value of an expression across a group of rows.

name: MIN
description: Returns the smallest non-NULL value of an expression across a group of rows.

name: MOD
description: Returns the remainder of dividing one number by another, with the sign of the dividend, and an error when the divisor is zero.

name: NORMALIZE
description: Converts a string to one of the four Unicode normalization forms, NFC by default.

name: NORMALIZE_AND_CASEFOLD
description: Normalizes a string and applies case folding so that comparisons ignore letter case and equivalent character forms.

name: NTH_VALUE
description: Returns the value of an expression from the Nth row of the current window frame, or NULL if that row does not exist.

name: NTILE
description: Divides the rows of a window partition into a given number of roughly equal buckets and returns each row's bucket number.

name: NULLIF
description: Returns NULL when two expressions are equal, and otherwise returns the first expression.

name: NULLIFERROR
description: Evaluates an expression and returns its result, or NULL if evaluating it raises an error.

name: OCTET_LENGTH
description: An alias of BYTE_LENGTH that returns the number of bytes in a string or bytes value.

name: PARSE_DATE
description: Converts a string to a date by reading it with a format pattern.

name: PARSE_TIMESTAMP
description: Converts a string to a timestamp by reading it with a format pattern, optionally in a given time zone.

name: PERCENTILE_CONT
description: Returns a percentile of a set of values, interpolating between the nearest values when it falls between two.

name: PERCENTILE_DISC
description: Returns the first value in sorted order whose cumulative distribution reaches or exceeds a given percentile.

name: PERCENT_RANK
description: Returns the relative rank of the current row within its window partition as a fraction between 0 and 1.

name: POW
description: Returns the first number raised to the power of the second, giving zero if the result underflows.

name: POWER
description: A synonym of POW that raises a number to a given power.

name: RAND
description: Returns a pseudo-random floating-point number from 0 up to but not including 1.

name: RANK
description: Returns the rank of the current row within its window partition, giving tied rows the same rank and skipping the ranks after them.

name: REGEXP_CONTAINS
description: Returns TRUE if any part of a value matches a regular expression.

name: REGEXP_EXTRACT
description: Returns the first substring of a value that matches a regular expression, or its first capturing group when it has one.

name: REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL
description: Returns an array of every non-overlapping substring of a value that matches a regular expression.

name: REGEXP_INSTR
description: Returns the 1-based position of a regular expression match in a value, with optional start position and occurrence.

name: REGEXP_REPLACE
description: Returns a string in which every substring matching a regular expression is replaced with a replacement.

name: REPEAT
description: Returns a string or bytes value made by repeating the original value a given number of times.

name: REPLACE
description: Replaces every occurrence of a pattern in a string or bytes value with a replacement.

name: REVERSE
description: Returns a string with its characters in reverse order, or a bytes value with its bytes in reverse order.

name: RIGHT
description: Returns the rightmost characters of a string, or the rightmost bytes of a bytes value, up to the requested length.

name: ROUND
description: Rounds a number to the nearest whole number, or to a given number of decimal places, with halves rounded away from zero.

name: ROW_NUMBER
description: Returns a sequential number for each row in a window partition, starting at 1 and following the window ordering.

name: RPAD
description: Pads the end of a value with a repeating pattern until it reaches a target length, or truncates it if it is longer.

name: RTRIM
description: Removes the given characters, or spaces by default, from the end of a string or bytes value.

name: S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT
description: Returns the ID of the S2 grid cell that covers a point on the Earth's surface.

name: S2_COVERINGCELLIDS
description: Returns an array of S2 cell IDs that together cover a geography, which supports indexing geographic data by cell.

name: SAFE_ADD
description: Adds two numbers like the plus operator, but returns NULL instead of raising an error on overflow.

name: SAFE_CAST
description: Converts a value to a specified type like CAST, but returns NULL instead of raising an error when the conversion fails.

name: SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING
description: Converts a bytes value to a string, replacing any invalid UTF-8 sequences with the Unicode replacement character.

name: SAFE_DIVIDE
description: Divides two numbers like the division operator, but returns NULL instead of raising an error such as division by zero.

name: SAFE_MULTIPLY
description: Multiplies two numbers like the multiplication operator, but returns NULL instead of raising an error on overflow.

name: SAFE_NEGATE
description: Negates a number like the unary minus operator, but returns NULL instead of raising an error on overflow.

name: SAFE_SUBTRACT
description: Subtracts one number from another like the minus operator, but returns NULL instead of raising an error on overflow.

name: SEC
description: Returns the secant of an angle given in radians, which is the reciprocal of its cosine.

name: SECH
description: Returns the hyperbolic secant of a number, which is the reciprocal of its hyperbolic cosine.

name: SIGN
description: Returns -1, 0 or +1 depending on whether a number is negative, zero or positive.

name: SIN
description: Returns the sine of an angle given in radians, as a value between -1 and 1.

name: SINH
description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a number, and raises an error if the result overflows.

name: SOUNDEX
description: Returns the Soundex phonetic code of a string, which gives similar-sounding words the same code.

name: SPLIT
description: Splits a string or bytes value into an array of parts at each occurrence of a delimiter.

name: SQRT
description: Returns the square root of a number, and raises an error if the number is negative.

name: STARTS_WITH
description: Returns TRUE when a value begins with the given prefix, for both strings and bytes.

name: STDDEV
description: Returns the sample standard deviation of a numeric column across a group of rows; a synonym of STDDEV_SAMP.

name: STDDEV_POP
description: Returns the population standard deviation of a numeric column across a group of rows.

name: STDDEV_SAMP
description: Returns the sample standard deviation, using the n minus 1 correction, of a numeric column across a group of rows.

name: STRING
description: Converts a timestamp to a string, optionally rendered in a given time zone.

name: STRING_AGG
description: Joins the non-NULL string or bytes values of a group of rows into one value, separated by a delimiter that defaults to a comma.

name: STRPOS
description: Returns the 1-based position of the first occurrence of a substring in a value, or 0 if it does not occur.

name: ST_ACCUM
description: Aggregates the geography values of a group of rows into an array of geographies.

name: ST_ANGLE
description: Returns the angle in radians between two lines defined by three point geographies, measured clockwise from the first line.

name: ST_AREA
description: Returns the area in square meters covered by the polygons in a geography.

name: ST_ASBINARY
description: Converts a geography to its well-known binary representation as a bytes value.

name: ST_ASGEOJSON
description: Converts a geography to a GeoJSON geometry string.

name: ST_ASKML
description: Converts a geography to a string in KML geometry format.

name: ST_ASTEXT
description: Converts a geography to its well-known text representation as a string.

name: ST_AZIMUTH
description: Returns the azimuth in radians of the line segment from one point geography to another, measured clockwise from north.

name: ST_BOUNDARY
description: Returns a geography made from the boundaries of the components of the input geography.

name: ST_BOUNDINGBOX
description: Returns the bounding box of a geography as a struct with its minimum and maximum longitude and latitude.

name: ST_BUFFER
description: Returns a geography covering all points within a given distance of the input, approximated with a number of segments.

name: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE
description: Returns a geography covering all points within a given distance of the input, approximated to within a tolerance.

name: ST_CENTROID
description: Returns the centroid of a geography, the center of mass of its components, as a point geography.

name: ST_CLOSESTPOINT
description: Returns the point on the first geography that is closest to the second geography.

name: ST_CONTAINS
description: Returns TRUE if the first geography contains the second, so no point of the second lies outside it and their interiors intersect.

name: ST_CONVEXHULL
description: Returns the smallest convex geography that covers the input geography.

name: ST_COVEREDBY
description: Returns TRUE if no point of the first geography lies outside the second geography.

name: ST_COVERS
description: Returns TRUE if no point of the second geography lies outside the first geography.

name: ST_DIFFERENCE
description: Returns the part of the first geography that does not intersect the second geography.

name: ST_DIMENSION
description: Returns the dimension of the highest-dimensional element of a geography: 0 for points, 1 for lines and 2 for polygons.

name: ST_DISJOINT
description: Returns TRUE if two geographies have no points in common.

name: ST_DISTANCE
description: Returns the shortest distance in meters between two geographies.

name: ST_DUMP
description: Returns an array of the simple geographies, such as single points, lines and polygons, that make up a geography.

name: ST_DUMPPOINTS
description: Returns an array of point geographies, one for every point and vertex in a geography.

name: ST_DWITHIN
description: Returns TRUE if any points of two geographies are within a given distance of each other.

name: ST_ENDPOINT
description: Returns the last point of a linestring geography as a point geography.

name: ST_EQUALS
description: Returns TRUE if two geographies represent the same set of points.

name: ST_EXTENT
description: Returns the bounding box that contains all the geographies of a group of rows.

name: ST_EXTERIORRING
description: Returns the outermost ring of a polygon geography as a linestring.

name: ST_GEOGFROM
description: Converts a string or bytes value in a supported format, such as WKT, WKB or GeoJSON, into a geography.

name: ST_GEOGFROMGEOJSON
description: Converts a GeoJSON geometry string into a geography.

name: ST_GEOGFROMKML
description: Converts a string in KML geometry format into a geography value.

name: ST_GEOGFROMTEXT
description: Converts a well-known text string into a geography.

name: ST_GEOGFROMWKB
description: Converts well-known binary bytes, or a hexadecimal well-known binary string, into a geography.

name: ST_GEOGPOINT
description: Creates a point geography from a longitude and a latitude in degrees.

name: ST_GEOGPOINTFROMGEOHASH
description: Returns a point geography at the center of the bounding box that a GeoHash string describes.

name: ST_GEOHASH
description: Converts a point geography to a GeoHash string, which encodes the location as a short text code.

name: ST_GEOMETRYTYPE
description: Returns the OGC geometry type of a geography, such as ST_Point, ST_LineString or ST_Polygon.

name: ST_HAUSDORFFDISTANCE
description: Returns the discrete Hausdorff distance between two geographies, a measure of how far apart their shapes are.

name: ST_HAUSDORFFDWITHIN
description: Returns TRUE if the Hausdorff distance between two geographies is within a given distance.

name: ST_INTERIORRINGS
description: Returns the interior rings, which are the holes, of a polygon geography as an array of linestrings.

name: ST_INTERSECTION
description: Returns the set of points that two geographies have in common.

name: ST_INTERSECTS
description: Returns TRUE if two geographies share at least one point.

name: ST_INTERSECTSBOX
description: Returns TRUE if a geography intersects a rectangle given by its longitude and latitude bounds.

name: ST_ISCLOSED
description: Returns TRUE if every element of a non-empty geography is closed, meaning it has an empty boundary.

name: ST_ISCOLLECTION
description: Returns TRUE if a geography contains more than one point, linestring or polygon in total.

name: ST_ISEMPTY
description: Returns TRUE if a geography contains no points, meaning it is the empty geography.

name: ST_ISRING
description: Returns TRUE if a geography is a closed linestring that does not cross itself.

name: ST_LENGTH
description: Returns the total length in meters of the lines in a geography.

name: ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT
description: Returns the point at a given fraction of the way along a linestring geography.

name: ST_LINELOCATEPOINT
description: Returns the fraction of a linestring's length that lies between its start and the point on it closest to a given point.

name: ST_LINESUBSTRING
description: Returns the part of a single linestring that lies between a starting and an ending fraction of its length.

name: ST_MAKELINE
description: Creates a linestring by connecting the points, and the vertices of linestrings, of the input geographies in order.

name: ST_MAKEPOLYGON
description: Constructs a polygon from a linestring shell and optional linestring holes.

name: ST_MAKEPOLYGONORIENTED
description: Constructs a polygon from an array of linestrings, using the vertex order to set each ring's orientation.

name: ST_MAXDISTANCE
description: Returns the longest distance in meters between a pair of points, one from each of two non-empty geographies.

name: ST_NPOINTS
description: An alias of ST_NUMPOINTS that returns the number of vertices in a geography.

name: ST_NUMGEOMETRIES
description: Returns the number of geometries, such as points, lines and polygons, in a geography.

name: ST_NUMPOINTS
description: Returns the total number of vertices across all the elements of a geography.

name: ST_PERIMETER
description: Returns the length in meters of the boundaries of the polygons in a geography.

name: ST_POINTN
description: Returns the point at a given position among the vertices of a linestring geography.

name: ST_SIMPLIFY
description: Returns a simplified version of a geography with fewer vertices, within a given tolerance.

name: ST_SNAPTOGRID
description: Returns a geography with every vertex snapped to a longitude and latitude grid of a given size.

name: ST_STARTPOINT
description: Returns the first point of a linestring geography as a point geography.

name: ST_TOUCHES
description: Returns TRUE if two geographies intersect only at their boundaries, with no shared interior points.

name: ST_UNION
description: Returns the set of points that belong to any of the input geographies.

name: ST_UNION_AGG
description: Aggregates the geographies of a group of rows and returns the union of all their points.

name: ST_WITHIN
description: Returns TRUE if the first geography lies inside the second, so that no point of it falls outside the second.

name: SUBSTR
description: Returns part of a string or bytes value, starting at a position and optionally limited to a given length.

name: SUBSTRING
description: An alias of SUBSTR that returns a portion of a string or bytes value from a starting position.

name: SUM
description: Returns the sum of the non-NULL values of an expression across a group of rows.

name: TAN
description: Returns the tangent of an angle given in radians, and raises an error if the result overflows.

name: TANH
description: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a number, a value between -1 and 1.

name: TIMESTAMP
description: Builds a timestamp from a string, a date or a datetime, optionally interpreting it in a given time zone.

name: TIMESTAMP_ADD
description: Adds a whole number of time units, such as seconds, minutes, hours or days, to a timestamp.

name: TIMESTAMP_DIFF
description: Returns the number of whole units, at a chosen granularity, between two timestamps.

name: TIMESTAMP_FROM_UNIX_MICROS
description: Converts microseconds since the Unix epoch into a timestamp, and returns a timestamp argument unchanged.

name: TIMESTAMP_FROM_UNIX_MILLIS
description: Converts milliseconds since the Unix epoch into a timestamp, and returns a timestamp argument unchanged.

name: TIMESTAMP_FROM_UNIX_SECONDS
description: Converts seconds since the Unix epoch into a timestamp, and returns a timestamp argument unchanged.

name: TIMESTAMP_MICROS
description: Converts an integer number of microseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC into a timestamp.

name: TIMESTAMP_MILLIS
description: Converts an integer number of milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC into a timestamp.

name: TIMESTAMP_SECONDS
description: Converts an integer number of seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC into a timestamp.

name: TIMESTAMP_SUB
description: Subtracts a whole number of time units, such as seconds, minutes, hours or days, from a timestamp.

name: TIMESTAMP_TRUNC
description: Rounds a timestamp down to the start of a chosen granularity, such as hour, day or month.

name: TO_BASE32
description: Encodes a bytes value as a base32 text string, which stores or transmits binary data as text.

name: TO_BASE64
description: Encodes a bytes value as a base64 text string, which stores or transmits binary data as text.

name: TO_CODE_POINTS
description: Converts a string or bytes value into an array holding the code point or byte value of each character.

name: TO_FLOAT32
description: Converts four big-endian bytes holding an IEEE 754 single-precision number into a 32-bit floating-point value.

name: TO_FLOAT64
description: Converts eight big-endian bytes holding an IEEE 754 double-precision number into a 64-bit floating-point value.

name: TO_HEX
description: Encodes a bytes value as a hexadecimal string with two digits per byte.

name: TO_INT64
description: Converts eight big-endian bytes holding a signed integer into a 64-bit integer value.

name: TO_JSON_STRING
description: Converts a value of any supported type to its JSON text form.

name: TO_VECTOR32
description: Converts bytes holding big-endian 32-bit floating-point numbers into an array of 32-bit floats.

name: TO_VECTOR64
description: Converts bytes holding big-endian 64-bit floating-point numbers into an array of 64-bit floats.

name: TRANSLATE
description: Replaces each character of a value found in a source set with the character at the same position in a target set.

name: TRIM
description: Removes the given characters, or spaces by default, from both the start and the end of a string or bytes value.

name: TRUNC
description: Rounds a number toward zero to a whole number or to a given number of decimal places.

name: UNICODE
description: Returns the Unicode code point of the first character of a string, or 0 for an empty string.

name: UNIX_DATE
description: Converts a date into the number of days since 1970-01-01.

name: UNIX_MICROS
description: Returns the number of microseconds from the Unix epoch to a timestamp.

name: UNIX_MILLIS
description: Returns the number of milliseconds since the Unix epoch for a timestamp, rounding down.

name: UNIX_SECONDS
description: Returns the number of seconds since the Unix epoch for a timestamp, rounding down.

name: UNPACK
description: Expands a table read with history into one row per timestamped cell value, putting each cell timestamp in a column named _timestamp.

name: UPPER
description: Converts the letters in a string to uppercase, or the ASCII letters in a bytes value.

name: VARIANCE
description: Returns the sample variance of a numeric column across a group of rows; a synonym of VAR_SAMP.

name: VAR_POP
description: Returns the population variance of a numeric column across a group of rows.

name: VAR_SAMP
description: Returns the sample variance, using the n minus 1 correction, of a numeric column across a group of rows.

name: VIEW_PARAMETERS
description: Reads a caller-supplied string parameter, such as a user ID, inside a logical view definition to scope what the view returns.
